description: 2044 is the Year of the Wood Rat in the Chinese zodiac, from January 30, 2044 to February 16, 2045. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2044 is the Year of the Wood Rat, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 30, 2044 and ended on February 16, 2045, so people born in 2044 before Jan 30 belong to the Water Pig year.

sections.heading: Dates of the 2044 Rat year
paragraphs: The Wood Rat year of 2044 started on January 30, 2044, when Lunar New Year arrived, and ended on February 16, 2045. Births from New Year's Day to the day before Jan 30 fall in the Water Pig year instead, and births in 2045 up to Feb 16 remain Wood Rat. Because the year follows the moon, its start can be as early as January 21 or as late as February 20, and anyone with a birthday in that window should check the exact date rather than rely on the calendar year. Earlier Wood Rat years in the table are 1924 and 1984; the combination comes round once every sixty years. New year's day was a Saturday, and the Sun stood in Aquarius.

sections.heading: The 2044 Wood Rat character
paragraphs: The main growth edge for a Wood Rat is pacing. Because both the stem and the animal enjoy opportunity, it is easy to say yes to every promising idea and quietly run dry. Readings often suggest keeping a short list of commitments and reviewing it each season, dropping whatever no longer fits. The Rat's background anxiety can also surface as people-pleasing in this combination, so practising a polite refusal is worthwhile. Time alone, near water or simply in quiet, tends to restore the reserves that Wood draws down. When it gives from a full cup rather than an empty one, the Wood Rat's generosity becomes one of its finest qualities.

At work, the Wood element is usually linked with planning, teaching and collaborative building. Wood-year people are often described as good at seeing how a team could grow and at nurturing the people inside it, which suits roles in education, design, community work, healthcare and any field with a long horizon. They tend to prefer cooperation over rivalry. The traditional warning is about scope: a Wood stem can start more ventures than it can finish, so firm priorities and honest deadlines usually serve it well.

sections.heading: The 2044 year number and branch
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits reduce to 1, the number of beginnings, initiative and independence, so numerologists describe a 1 year as one that rewards starting things. The digits of 2044 add up to 10, which reduces to 1. Among the twelve branches the Rat comes first, a Yang animal whose fixed element is Water. Paired with a Wood year, water generates Wood. The year before was the Water Pig and the year after is the Wood Ox.

Its stem-branch name is Jia-Zi, the Wood stem Jia joined to the Rat's branch Zi, both of them Yang. The same name was used for 1984 and comes back in 2104, which is how the traditional calendar counts its sixty-year cycles without numbering the years.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2044?
faq.answer: 2044 is the Year of the Wood Rat. It started on January 30, 2044 and ended on February 16, 2045.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2044?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 30. Born before January 30, 2044, you are a Water Pig; born on or after it, you are a Wood Rat.

faq.question: What element is 2044 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Wood, a Yang year. The Rat's own fixed element is Water; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2044?
faq.answer: Jia-Zi. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Wood Rat year?
faq.answer: 2104, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1924 and 1984.
